summary: Increased font sizes on the AFK page for all seven targeted CSS classes (afk-section-heading, afk-code-pre, afk-api-call, afk-api-phase-label, afk-code-block-label, afk-data-flow-table, and afk-data-flow-table th) from their original 9–10.5px values to the specified 10–12.5px targets, with CSS-only changes and no JSX modifications.
